items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I sat in with his big band at the Half Note one night

ctx.x: For Donald Erb the composer. How did you and Joe Henderson decide on “You Don’t Know What Love Is”?
I think I sat in with his big band at the Half Note one night and we did something and decided to play that tune. Maybe that’s how.
